experimental_design: comparison of PfCHT1 complex formation in P. falciparum vs chimeric P. berghei (Pb-PfCHT1(r))

To test the hypothesis that ookinete-produced PfCHT1 can form a high molecular homo-multimer or, alternatively, interacts with P. berghei ookinete-produced proteins to produce an HMW hetero-multimer, we created chimeric P. berghei parasites expressing PfCHT1 to replace PbCHT1
factor_value: In vitro production of P. berghei ookinetes for the three parasitic cell lines Pb-PfCHT1(r), PbCHT1 (WT) and PbΔCHT1 was carried out
number_of_samples: Mass spectrometry analysis was carried out on the chitin affinity pulled down proteins from the Pb-PfCHT1(r) ookinete culture supernatant
